en_title: GTA 6 Players Report Crashes on PS5 With Error CE-108255-1
cn_title: 《GTA 6》玩家报告PS5上出现崩溃，错误代码为CE-108255-1
opus_summary: 部分《GTA6》玩家报告，游戏在PS5上频繁崩溃并出现CE-108255-1错误，有人称因此无法推进剧情。标准版PS5和PS5 Pro玩家均报告遇到问题，目前尚不清楚问题源于主机还是游戏本身，也没有普遍有效的解决方法。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 players on PlayStation 5 have reported frequent crashes tied to error code CE-108255-1, and it looks like it's blocking them from progressing through the story while they wait for Sony and Rockstar to send out a fix.
paragraphs.cn: PS5上的《GTA 6》玩家报告称，游戏频繁崩溃，并出现错误代码CE-108255-1。在他们等待索尼和Rockstar推出修复补丁期间，这一问题似乎阻碍了他们推进剧情。

paragraphs.en: Although Rockstar Games spent a decade making its new Grand Theft Auto game, it's no surprise to see the new highest-rated game of all time launching with at least a few hiccups. Some have it worse than others, though, with more than a few reports of crashes affecting PS5 consoles popping up online in the days following GTA 6's launch.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管Rockstar花了十年制作这款新的《侠盗猎车手》游戏，但这款有史以来评分最高的新游戏在推出时出现至少几个小问题，也并不令人意外。不过，有些玩家的遭遇比其他人更糟：《GTA 6》发售后的几天里，网上出现了不少有关PS5主机遭遇游戏崩溃的报告。

paragraphs.en: The most common cause seems to be tied to error code CE-108255-1, which, as defined by Sony , simply indicates that "an error occurred with the game/application." It seems that, although the majority of players aren't encountering the issue, those who have haven't been able to find a proper fix. Adding to the trouble is that those who have met these dreaded GTA 6 crashes are getting them pretty frequently, and what's triggering them isn't always clear. There are reports from players on both standard PS5 and PS5 Pro consoles running into these issues, with some even saying that crashes appear to be tied to the story, barring them from making any progress.
paragraphs.cn: 最常见的原因似乎与错误代码CE-108255-1有关。按照索尼的定义，这个代码仅表示「游戏／应用程序发生了错误」。尽管大多数玩家似乎没有遇到这一问题，但遇到问题的玩家似乎也没能找到合适的解决办法。更麻烦的是，遭遇这些令人头疼的《GTA 6》崩溃问题的玩家遇到崩溃的频率相当高，而且触发原因也并非总是明确。有使用标准版PS5和PS5 Pro主机的玩家报告遇到了这些问题，有些人甚至表示，崩溃似乎与剧情有关，让他们无法取得任何进展。

paragraphs.en: "I've noticed that the issue manifests differently for different players," one Reddit user said . "In my case, the game crashes on Jason's loading screen: it freezes and then displays the CE-108255-1 error code, meaning I can't even get into the game. Others manage to play for a few minutes before experiencing a crash. I really hope Sony and Rockstar work together to investigate and resolve this issue as soon as possible."
paragraphs.cn: 一名Reddit用户说：「我注意到，这个问题在不同玩家身上的表现不同。我的情况是，游戏在Jason的加载画面崩溃：画面先卡住，然后显示CE-108255-1错误代码，这意味着我甚至进不了游戏。其他人则能玩上几分钟，然后才遇到崩溃。我真希望索尼和Rockstar能合作调查并尽快解决这个问题。」

paragraphs.en: Game crashes are annoying for anyone, but when a massive game like GTA 6, which many feel has a less-than-generous autosave system , suddenly boots players back to the PS5 home screen without warning, it can be especially troublesome. Many who have reported the crashes to PlayStation Support say they've been directed to Rockstar, while those who report to Rockstar say they're being directed to PlayStation. One player said they feel like they're "stuck in an endless support loop, with a game I paid for and still can't play."
paragraphs.cn: 游戏崩溃对任何人来说都很烦人，但当《GTA 6》这样一款大型游戏毫无预警地突然将玩家踢回PS5主屏幕时，情况可能尤其令人头疼，因为许多人认为它的自动存档系统不够宽裕。许多向PlayStation支持部门报告崩溃问题的玩家表示，他们被转到了Rockstar；而向Rockstar报告的玩家则表示，自己被转到了PlayStation。一名玩家说，他们感觉自己「陷入了无休止的客服循环，买了游戏却还是玩不了」。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, those who have managed to get help say most assistance hasn't been able to completely resolve their issues. However, some have said they've had luck with a few tried-and-true methods, such as uninstalling and reinstalling the game, making sure both the PS5 and game have their most recent updates, and restoring licenses.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，成功获得帮助的玩家表示，大多数协助都没能彻底解决他们的问题。不过，有些人说，一些经过验证的方法对他们奏效了，例如卸载并重新安装游戏、确保PS5和游戏都已更新至最新版本，以及恢复许可证。

paragraphs.en: "I’ve done everything possible to solve this," another player said . "Deleted cache. Rebuilt database, deleted everything else from my console, took it apart, cleaned it, turned HDR off, switched to 1080p, went and updated game license, deleted and reinstalled and still crashing. Ugh. I’ve got a day 1 PS5 with a disc drive. Other friends of mine with the same console are playing with no issue."
paragraphs.cn: 另一名玩家说：「我已经尝试了一切可能的办法来解决这个问题。删除缓存、重建数据库、删除主机上所有其他东西、拆开主机清洁、关闭HDR、切换到1080p、更新游戏许可证、删除并重新安装游戏，但还是崩溃。唉。我的是一台首发日购买的带光驱PS5。我的其他朋友用同款主机玩得没有任何问题。」

paragraphs.en: Again, it's unclear if the crashing issue is tied specifically to the PS5 or GTA 6 itself. Until either entity comes up with an update, though, all affected players are stuck on launch weekend.
paragraphs.cn: 再说一次，目前尚不清楚崩溃问题究竟是专门与PS5有关，还是与《GTA 6》本身有关。不过，在任何一方推出更新之前，所有受影响的玩家在发售周末都只能被困在原地。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 released for PS5 and Xbox Series X/S November 19 and, in its first 24 hours, made Rockstar $3.79 billion. It's the most successful launch in the history of entertainment , and although its exact unit sales have yet to be disclosed, parent company Take-Two Interactive was at least willing to share that it sold 32.5 million copies in pre-orders alone.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 6》于11月19日在PS5和XBOX Series平台发售，首个24小时便为Rockstar带来了37.9亿美元收入。这是娱乐业历史上最成功的一次发售。尽管确切销量尚未公布，母公司Take-Two Interactive至少愿意透露，游戏仅预购销量就达到了3250万份。

paragraphs.en: For more, you can read about the players unhappy with how Rockstar handled Jason's secret stash . You can also see the lengths the developers went to in order to create realistic NPCs , as well as the Neuralink user who spent launch driving around Leonida with his mind .
paragraphs.cn: 想了解更多，你可以阅读那些对Rockstar处理Jason秘密藏匿物方式感到不满的玩家的报道。你还可以看看开发者为了打造逼真的NPC付出了多大努力，以及一名Neuralink用户如何在游戏发售时用意念驾车游逛Leonida。

If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .
